The no true Scotsman fallacy also explains why no true Christian ever kills, no true communist state is repressive,One can always maintain a belief, no matter what it is, by saying that the burden of proof is on those who disagree Bertrand Russell responded to this fallacy when he was challenged to explain why he was an atheist rather than an agnostic, since he could not prove that God does not exist. However, Miss Henderson had a special gift for noticing subtleties in nature.\n\nUpon closer inspection, she noticed a seemingly out-of-place glow emanating from Mubbly Bubbly’s core. Intrigued, she felt a connection to this mysterious feature of the park. With great care and tenderness, Miss Henderson placed a small communication device on top of the volcano. It was a reminder of the uniqueness and fluidity of their bond.
